2608.01324.title: G-ReAct: Graph-Guided Deep Search via Structure-State Co-Evolution
2608.01324.paper_summary: Deep search has become a fundamental capability of large language models (LLMs) for solving open-domain complex tasks. However, existing approaches typically rely on linear sequential reasoning for both trajectory generation and inference, making it difficult to consistently preserve intermediate states and constraints throughout long-horizon multi-hop search. Consequently, they often suffer from context forgetting, search drift, and inefficient exploration. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{G-ReAct}$, a reasoning framework for deep search that organizes reasoning as $\textbf{state evolution over a fixed-topology query graph}$. The evolving graph state explicitly tracks search progress and guides subsequent decisions, transforming exploratory search driven by textual history into graph-guided reasoning under explicit constraints. G-ReAct supports both training and inference: it generates high-quality deep-search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and provides structured guidance for inference-time search without additional fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate that with only 1.9K generated trajectories for fine-tuning, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 achieves $52.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-ZH and $79.0\%$ on XBench, outperforming comparable open-source methods trained on substantially larger datasets, including RL-enhanced methods. Furthermore, when applied at inference time, G-ReAct consistently improves the performance of existing strong LLMs on deep-search tasks. We will publicly release all code and model weights.
2608.01324.paper_summary_zh: 深度搜索已成為大型語言模型（LLMs）解決開放領域複雜任務的基本能力。<lb/>然而，現有的方法通常依賴於線性順序推理來生成軌跡和進行推斷，這使得在長時間範圍的多跳搜索中，始終保持中間狀態和約束變得困難。<lb/>因此，它們常常遭受上下文遺忘、搜索漂移和低效探索的問題。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 $\textbf{G-ReAct}$，一種將推理組織為 $\textbf{固定拓撲查詢圖上的狀態演變}$ 的深度搜索推理框架。<lb/>演變的圖狀態明確跟踪搜索進度並指導後續決策，將由文本歷史驅動的探索性搜索轉變為在明確約束下的圖引導推理。<lb/>G-ReAct 支持訓練和推斷：它生成高質量的深度搜索軌跡以進行有監督的微調，並在推斷時提供結構化指導，而無需額外的微調。<lb/>實驗表明，僅用 1.9K 生成的軌跡進行微調，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 在 BrowseComp-ZH 上達到 $52.6\%$ 的準確率，在 XBench 上達到 $79.0\%$，超越了在更大數據集上訓練的可比較開源方法，包括增強強化學習的方法。<lb/>此外，當在推斷時應用時，G-ReAct 一直在深度搜索任務上持續提高現有強大 LLM 的性能。<lb/>我們將公開釋放所有代碼和模型權重。
